resource.title: Grok Bot × 热帖观察：用快照与去重验证监控规则
resource.title_en: Grok Bot × post monitoring: validate signals with snapshots and deduplication
resource.author: @aehyok
resource.summary_zh: 已补作者公开Skill、Routine与失败归档，核对严格阈值和实际间隔；首次观测两套公式有差异。仓库没有独立采集脚本，网页模型演示也不证明监控跑通。未实测。
resource.summary_en: Author Skill, routine and failure archive reviewed: strict thresholds, elapsed intervals and differing first-sighting formulas. No standalone collector; the model demo does not prove a running monitor. Untested.
resource.verification_note_zh: 固定作者仓库8ad0a75，完整读Skill、Routine，核对状态、0909读取失败归档和账号精简提交。首次观测分母下限为1分钟/1小时两种，独立算例为12000/h对1000/h；等于5000不达标。旧12账号归档与新2账号配置按历史解释。无独立采集脚本、许可证声明或实时复现；免费API和外部模型代提交未核实。
resource.verification_note_en: Pinned author repository 8ad0a75: full Skill/routine plus state, 0909 read-failure archive and account-reduction commit reviewed. First-sighting floors differ by one minute/one hour, producing 12000/h versus 1000/h in a synthetic check; exactly 5000 does not qualify. Historical twelve-account archives are distinct from the new two-account configuration. No standalone collector, license declaration or live reproduction; free APIs and delegated commits unverified.
